command.mushocraft.life.info: %s: %s years old (%s), born at game tick %s.
command.mushocraft.life.setage: Set the age of %s player(s) to %s years.
command.mushocraft.mana.set: Set the mana of %s player(s) to %s.
command.mushocraft.mana.trained: Set the trained capacity of %s player(s) to %s.
item.mushocraft.conjured.tooltip: Conjured: melts away after a while
death.attack.mushocraft.spell: %1$s was struck down by a spell
screen.mushocraft.spellbook.locked: %s · not learned yet: a teacher or a book will show it to you
screen.mushocraft.spellbook.help: Drag a move onto a slot · right-click a slot to empty it · keys 1-9 in battle mode (R)
screen.mushocraft.moves.none: You do not know any move yet. Read a spell book.
screen.mushocraft.moves.help: Click a move, then a slot. Right-click a slot to empty it. In battle mode (R), keys 1-9 use the moves.
message.mushocraft.move.empty_slot: This slot is empty (J to fill it).
message.mushocraft.lesson.show: Watch closely: %s. Repeat it until it is yours.
message.mushocraft.lesson.practise: You do not master %s yet (%s). Repeat it again and again.
message.mushocraft.lesson.nothing_more: I have nothing more to teach you.
message.mushocraft.master.disciple: From today, you are my disciple in the %s.
message.mushocraft.master.body: Your body is not ready for the rank of %s. Train it first (%s%% of %s%%).
message.mushocraft.master.aura: You master every technique, but the rank of %2$s requires Battle Aura: %1$s.
message.mushocraft.tutor.mana: Your mana is too weak for the spells of the rank of %s (%s of %s).
message.mushocraft.move.botched: You botched %s: you do not master it yet (%s).
message.mushocraft.magic.abbreviated_unl: You know %s well enough to truncate its incantation.
message.mushocraft.magic.silent_unlocked: Your mana obeys your mind: you can now cast the spells you master without a word.
message.mushocraft.magic.abandoned: You let go: the chant of %s fades.
message.mushocraft.magic.book_known: You already know everything in this book.
spell.mushocraft.water_ball.desc: Materializes and hurls a mass of water.
spell.mushocraft.water_shield.desc: Raises a spout of water from the ground as a defensive wall.
spell.mushocraft.water_arrow.desc: Launches a quick bolt of water at a target.
spell.mushocraft.ice_smash.desc: Strikes an opponent with a mound of ice that slows them.
spell.mushocraft.ice_blade.desc: Creates a sword made out of ice. It melts after a minute.
spell.mushocraft.fireball.desc: Materializes and launches a spherule of fire.
spell.mushocraft.rock_bullet.desc: Materializes a bullet-sized rock and fires it.
spell.mushocraft.healing.desc: Heals minor wounds of whoever you look at, or yourself.
spell.mushocraft.detoxification.desc: Cleanses poison and sickness from your body.
spell.mushocraft.magic_shield.desc: A translucent barrier that weakens magic, heat and cold.
spell.mushocraft.exorcist_light.desc: A bolt of white light that harms spirits and the undead.
message.mushocraft.magic.rank_up: Your %s has reached the rank of %s!
message.mushocraft.magic.not_ready: %s is beyond you for now: it needs %s at the %s rank.
message.mushocraft.magic.book_too_hard: This book is too advanced for you yet. Keep practising.
spell.mushocraft.water_cannon.desc: Launches forth a large concentration of water that sweeps foes away.
spell.mushocraft.ice_pillar.desc: A shaft of ice springs up from the ground where you aim.
spell.mushocraft.flame_pillar.desc: A pillar of fire rises where you aim.
spell.mushocraft.explosion.desc: Creates an explosion where you aim. Never breaks blocks.
spell.mushocraft.ex_flame.desc: Launches a fireball two meters across that bursts on impact.
spell.mushocraft.sonic_boom.desc: A slicing wind blade that throws the target away.
spell.mushocraft.wind_slice.desc: Shoots a gust of cutting wind.
spell.mushocraft.stone_cannon.desc: Fires a bullet-shaped rock at great speed.
spell.mushocraft.earth_pillar.desc: Drops a boulder on the target from above.
spell.mushocraft.earth_lance.desc: An earthen spike rises from the ground where you aim.
spell.mushocraft.x_healing.desc: Heals wounds as severe as broken bones.
spell.mushocraft.physical_shield.desc: A barrier that weakens blows and missiles.
command.mushocraft.max: Made %s player(s) as strong as possible in every discipline.
message.mushocraft.aura.cannot_control: You cannot raise your Battle Aura at will yet.
message.mushocraft.aura.no_mana: Not enough mana to keep your Battle Aura.
command.mushocraft.body.aura: Set Battle Aura mastery to %s for %s player(s).
spell.mushocraft.blizzard_storm.desc: Shoots ice shards in every direction around you; they slow whoever they hit.
spell.mushocraft.squall.desc: Gathers the clouds and brings down rain.
spell.mushocraft.exodus_flame.desc: Releases a great wave of flame that explodes on impact. Its heat burns you briefly.
spell.mushocraft.sonic_blast.desc: A wide shockwave in front of you that hurts and hurls everything it catches.
spell.mushocraft.tornado_impact.desc: A spinning drill of wind that bores through every creature in its path.
spell.mushocraft.earth_fortress.desc: Raises walls and a roof of earth around you for a while.
spell.mushocraft.earth_hedgehog.desc: Earthen spikes burst from the ground all around the spot you aim at.
spell.mushocraft.dust_storm.desc: Conjures a storm of dust that blinds and slows those caught in it.
spell.mushocraft.shine_healing.desc: Heals grave wounds of a nearby ally, or your own.
spell.mushocraft.cumulonimbus.desc: Calls down a thundercloud: rain and lightning strike the area for a while.
spell.mushocraft.flash_over.desc: Flames spread over a very wide area in an instant.
spell.mushocraft.violent_storm.desc: A violent blast of wind all around you, hurling everything away.
spell.mushocraft.tornado.desc: A tornado that draws in, lifts and batters everything around it.
spell.mushocraft.sandstorm.desc: A fierce torrent of sand and wind that blinds, slows and weakens.
A barrier that holds the undead fast and wears them away.
spell.mushocraft.water_splash.desc: Countless droplets bombard the area and soak everyone in it.
spell.mushocraft.heat_hand.desc: Your hands grow hot enough to melt stone: your blows set foes alight.
spell.mushocraft.earth_wall.desc: Raises a wall of earth ahead of you.
spell.mushocraft.waterfall.desc: Water pours down without end, pressing down and soaking those beneath.
spell.mushocraft.flood_flush.desc: Floods the ground: creatures wade, slowed and soaked.
spell.mushocraft.icicle_field.desc: Freezes everything in the area, the soaked all the more.
spell.mushocraft.heat_island.desc: Heats your surroundings: you thaw and dry, foes scorch.
spell.mushocraft.burning_place.desc: A wreath of fire around you engulfs whoever comes close.
spell.mushocraft.flame_slice.desc: Shoots a blade of flame that sears and slices.
spell.mushocraft.wind_bind.desc: A whip of wind that ties your foe down.
spell.mushocraft.sand_cloud.desc: An earth bullet that bursts into a blinding cloud of sand.
entity.mushocraft.sword_master.title: %1$s Master · %2$s
entity.mushocraft.magic_tutor.title: %1$s Mage · %2$s
message.mushocraft.style.promoted: %s: you have reached the rank of %s!
message.mushocraft.technique.weapon.two_: %s needs a sword held with both hands.
command.mushocraft.style.promote: Promotion in %s by a %s master for %s player(s).
technique.mushocraft.arm_chop.desc: Initial Strike: aims at the forearm. Creatures drop their weapon, and the target is weakened.
technique.mushocraft.longsword_of_silenc: A cut beyond the speed of sound that leaves no sound behind.
The ultimate technique: all your force in one two-handed swing, near the speed of light.
technique.mushocraft.flow.desc: Receive the next attack, redirect its force and strike back. From Saint, also turns away missiles.
technique.mushocraft.sword_throwing.desc: Fling your weapon end over end. It lands where it hits: go and fetch it.
technique.mushocraft.four_legged_form.de: Charge low like a beast, a smaller target, and strike as you close in.
technique.mushocraft.moonlight_cleave.de: A secret technique: an upward swing whose shockwave sweeps away everyone in front.
spell.mushocraft.deep_mist.desc: A thick fog around you: those inside are blinded, and whatever hunts you loses your trail.
spell.mushocraft.magma_gush.desc: Lava bursts from the ground where you aim and leaves it molten for a while.
spell.mushocraft.quagmire.desc: Turns the ground into a swamp of mud that holds fast whoever stands in it.
spell.mushocraft.mud_rain.desc: A rain of mud: the ground turns slippery, no one can run, and some slip.
spell.mushocraft.blast.desc: A blast of hot wind in front of you that hurls and sets alight.
spell.mushocraft.frost_nova.desc: Soaks everything around the spot you aim at, then freezes it through.
spell.mushocraft.bora_blast.desc: A gust of freezing wind in front of you that freezes and numbs.
spell.mushocraft.icicle_break.desc: Launches a barrage of ice bolts at a target.
spell.mushocraft.icicle_edge.desc: Launches a crescent-shaped blade of ice that chills what it cuts.
spell.mushocraft.ice_lance.desc: An ice spike springs from the ground and impales the enemy.
spell.mushocraft.ice_fortress.desc: Raises a rampart of jagged ice slabs ahead, bursting slantwise out of the ground.
spell.mushocraft.absolute_zero.desc: Instantly freezes a very wide area around the caster; the water ices over.
spell.mushocraft.flamethrower.desc: Sweeps the area ahead with a jet of flames.
spell.mushocraft.wind_blast.desc: A strong gust that pushes away everything ahead, without harm.
spell.mushocraft.electric.desc: A small storm cloud over the target: its discharge shocks and paralyses, even through Battle Aura.
spell.mushocraft.antidote.desc: Cures the illnesses and strong poisons Detoxification cannot.
message.mushocraft.magic.disturbed: Your mana is scattered: nothing takes shape until it settles.
message.mushocraft.tutor.inherent_contro: My art asks for a sure control of mana. Come back once a school of magic is at Intermediate in your hands.
spell.mushocraft.disturb_magic.desc: Sends interfering mana into magic still taking shape, which scatters; also undoes shields and barriers. No chant. Long to master.
spell.mushocraft.howling.desc: A howl infused with mana that stuns those close around; weaker in a human's mouth than a beastman's. No chant. Long to master.
spell.mushocraft.lightning.desc: A thundercloud gathers over your target, then pours all its energy into a single bolt.
spell.mushocraft.confinement_barrier.des: Shuts the creature you aim at in a barrier it cannot leave, where no magic can be used.
message.mushocraft.magic.confined: You are shut in a barrier: magic cannot be used here.
item.mushocraft.summoning_paper.cost: Pour %s mana into it to perform the summoning (the paper is spent).
summon.mushocraft.lamplight: Radiant spirits circle you and light the dark, for a long while.
summon.mushocraft.spirit: A spirit made of your mana guards you and fights your foes; it feeds on your mana.
summon.mushocraft.beast: Calls a creature of the land and binds it to you. Too strong for your mana, it may break loose.
message.mushocraft.summon.not_enough_man: Not enough mana: this summoning needs %s.
message.mushocraft.summon.bound: %s answers your summoning and is bound to you.
message.mushocraft.summon.broke_loose: %s is too strong for your mana: it breaks loose!
